description: This file defines the interface class IGstGenericPlayerPrivate for a GStreamer-based media player component, including virtual methods for media data scheduling, pipeline control, and media caps updates.

classes.name: IGstGenericPlayerPrivate
classes.description: An interface class defining the private GStreamer media player operations, including scheduling media data, handling underflows, updating caps, and controlling pipeline state.

methods.name: scheduleNeedMediaData
methods.description: Schedules a need media data task, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: scheduleEnoughData
methods.description: Schedules enough data task, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: scheduleAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Schedules an audio underflow task, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: scheduleVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Schedules a video underflow task, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: scheduleAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Schedules all sources attached task, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: setWesterossinkRectangle
methods.description: Sets the Westeros sink rectangle, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Sends NeedMediaData notification, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: createBuffer
methods.description: Constructs a new buffer with data from media segment, does not perform decryption.

methods.name: attachAudioData
methods.description: Attaches audio data, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: attachVideoData
methods.description: Attaches video data, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: updateAudioCaps
methods.description: Checks and updates audio media segment metadata and caps.

methods.name: updateVideoCaps
methods.description: Checks and updates video media segment metadata and caps.

methods.name: startPositionReportingAndCheckAudioUnderflowTimer
methods.description: Starts position reporting and checks for audio underflow.

methods.name: stopPositionReportingAndCheckAudioUnderflowTimer
methods.description: Stops position reporting and checks for audio underflow.

methods.name: cancelUnderflow
methods.description: Restores playback after underflow, clears underflow flags.

methods.name: setPendingPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets pending playback rate after reaching PLAYING state.
